date_created_gt.description: Fetch tasks created after this time (ms or natural language).

date_created_lt.description: Fetch tasks created before this time (ms or natural language).

date_done_gt.description: Fetch tasks resolved/completed after this time (ms or natural language).

date_done_lt.description: Fetch tasks resolved/completed before this time (ms or natural language).

date_updated_gt.description: Fetch tasks updated after this time. Supports Unix timestamp (ms) or natural language (e.g., '3 days ago', 'last week'). Defaults to 7 days ago if no filters are provided. Use '0' to search all-time history.

date_updated_lt.description: Fetch tasks updated before this time (ms or natural language).

detail_level.description: Controls result verbosity. 'names' (ID/name only), 'summary' (flattened for AI context efficiency), or 'detailed' (full metadata). The server may automatically use 'summary' if results are large to stay within token limits.

due_date_gt.description: Fetch tasks due after this time (ms or natural language).

due_date_lt.description: Fetch tasks due before this time (ms or natural language).

folder_ids.description: Filter by exact ClickUp Folder IDs.

include_closed.description: If true, includes tasks in a "closed" status. Default is false.

order_by.description: The field to sort results by.

reverse.description: If true, sorts in descending order (e.g., newest first).
